blocks.text: LIVE: Alex Eala vs Diana Shnaider – Pan Pacific Open quarterfinals MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala lost another demanding battle against Diana Shnaider, ending her campaign at the Pan Pacific Open. In their second meeting in two weeks, Eala was beaten again by Shnaider, 2-6, 7-6(5), 6-4, in their quarterfinal match that lasted two hours and 52 minutes on Friday in Tokyo. The Filipino tennis standout also fell to the 22-year-old world No. 13 at the Ningbo Open in China, 7-5, 6-4, with the match lasting close to two hours.
